name: spoiti-lists
description: Your Spotify playlists and liked songs inside SpotiFLAC. Uses Spotify’s official API; lists refresh when you open them (home feed may cache a few minutes). No app build-time key is required.
author: AlexRabbit

settings.label: Spotify Client ID
settings.description: From Spotify Developer Dashboard. This is entered at runtime in SpotiFLAC, not baked into the extension build.

settings.label: Redirect URI
settings.description: Must match Spotify app settings exactly (default is usually fine).

settings.label: OAuth login URL
settings.description: Auto-filled by Connect. If callback fails, copy this URL into browser and use fallback code field.

settings.label: Connect to Spotify
settings.description: One tap: opens Spotify login in your browser and returns to SpotiFLAC.

settings.label: Show last login URL again
settings.description: Restores the last OAuth URL in the field above for troubleshooting.

settings.label: Authorization code (fallback)
settings.description: Usually not needed. Use only if callback is blocked; paste code= value (or full callback URL), save, then tap Finish login.

settings.label: Finish login (if needed)
settings.description: Fallback only. Usually not needed if callback opens SpotiFLAC.

settings.label: Get playback state
settings.description: Fetch the current Spotify playback state and active device.

settings.label: Play/Pause
settings.description: Toggle playback on the current active Spotify device.

settings.label: Next track
settings.description: Skip ahead to the next track on Spotify.

settings.label: Previous track
settings.description: Go back to the previous track on Spotify.

settings.label: Disconnect
settings.description: Clear Spotify login for this extension.
